params.prompt: Animate this exact painted scroll panel. The painting itself moves, never the camera: the large indigo crab's legs flex and creep very slowly sideways across the sleeping man's chest, one claw slowly opening and closing; the man's chest rises and falls in shallow breaths; the seated woman's hand gently strokes his foot; the small black snake in the corner slithers slowly out through the border and disappears. Everything moves like flat painted paper cutouts sliding over cloth — two-dimensional, stiff, no depth, no turning, figures stay in strict profile. The cloth texture, colors, outlines and composition stay exactly as in the first frame. The camera does not move: locked-off, fixed framing, no pan, no zoom. Single continuous take, no cuts. No new figures enter the frame.
